title: A read arc looks without taking
text: The transitions `serve` and `audit` both read `config`: each firing needs a token there but leaves it in place, so one token can enable many firings and two readers at once. Once `retire` consumes `config`, `serve` is not enabled, though a `job` still waits.

steps.text: The transition `serve` takes a `job` and reads `config`. The place `config` still holds its token.
The transition `audit` reads the same `config` token. Both readers were enabled at once, and each action got the token's value through `ctx.read(config)`.

The transition `retire` has an input arc on `config`, so it does consume the token. It has no output spec and the built-in passthrough action, which produces nothing; a transition with an output spec could not use passthrough.
A job waits, but the read place `config` is empty.
